title: Remove to-factory
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**

We don't use the advanced features of `to-factory`, so we don't need to rely on the dependency and its maintenance. Especially considering there's always some boilerplate at module boundaries

**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**

```js
const instantsearch = options => new InstantSearch(options);
```

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**

Leaving it as-is, spreading the options in case we have more than one argument

**Additional context**

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/9632ade6434fb9257bdb23c66dde8aaa1c31c4eb/src/lib/main.js#L173
